**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Make action-slug uniqueness atomic**

Two concurrent define_action calls can both reserve the same slug.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Rebuild carried dependencies from the current generation**

Incremental ingest can leave dangling dependencies when a callee no longer resolves.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->
